# Saborly

> Saborly is a 100% halal, Pakistani-style fast-food restaurant in Barcelona (C/ de Pere IV, 208, Sant Martí – Poblenou, 08005) and Sabadell (Av. Francesc Macià, 47, 08206), Spain. Burgers, smash burgers, pizzas, chicken tacos, fried and grilled chicken, milkshakes, alcohol-free mocktails and desserts. Order online at https://saborly.es for delivery or pickup.

Saborly es un restaurante de comida rápida 100 % halal de estilo paquistaní en Barcelona y Sabadell. Pedido online con entrega a domicilio o recogida.

- Phone (Barcelona): +34 932 11 20 72
- Email: info@saborly.es
- Languages on the site: Español, English, Català, العربية, Français

## Order

- [Menu and online ordering](https://saborly.es/menu): full menu, delivery or pickup
- [Offers](https://saborly.es/offer): current deals and combos

## Videos

- [All Saborly videos](https://saborly.es/videos/): dishes, locations, customer reviews and events, with FAQ
- [El sabor de Pakistán en Barcelona](https://saborly.es/videos/sabor-de-pakistan-en-barcelona/): Mozzarella sticks, pizza, burgers with fries, milkshakes and colourful mocktails — Pakistani-style halal fast food at Saborly in Barcelona.
- [Amigos, familia y buena comida](https://saborly.es/videos/amigos-familia-y-buena-comida/): A walk through Barcelona that ends at Saborly: burgers, grilled spicy chicken and mocktails — halal Pakistani fast food to share with friends and family.
- [Bueno, bonito y barato](https://saborly.es/videos/bueno-bonito-y-barato/): A customer calls Saborly the restaurant of the "3 Bs": good, nice and cheap — juicy burgers, must-try milkshakes and 100% halal food at budget-friendly prices.
- [Nauman Ijaz visita Saborly](https://saborly.es/videos/nauman-ijaz-visita-saborly/): Pakistani actor Nauman Ijaz visited Saborly in Barcelona, tried our burgers and drinks, and praised our Pakistani-style fast food.
- [Saborly en la Feria de Sabadell](https://saborly.es/videos/saborly-feria-de-sabadell/): Saborly joins the Sabadell Fair — come try our 100% halal smash burgers and pizzas at Saborly Sabadell, Av. Francesc Macià 47.
- [Reseña completa: burgers y pizza](https://saborly.es/videos/resena-burgers-y-pizza/): A three-minute, uncut review: a food creator (#reydelacomida) tries Saborly’s pizza, cheeseburgers, a wrap and more, and gives an honest verdict on each dish.
- [Mejor con quien más quieres](https://saborly.es/videos/mejor-con-quien-mas-quieres/): A day riding around the city that ends sharing pizza, burgers and drinks at Saborly — “an elegant, clean place and really tasty food.”
- [¿Burger o pizza?](https://saborly.es/videos/burger-o-pizza/): Burger or pizza? A quick look at Saborly’s halal burgers, pizzas and wraps — pick your favourite.
- [Tacos de pollo irresistibles](https://saborly.es/videos/tacos-de-pollo/): Chicken tacos with stretchy melted cheese, served hot in foil — halal, at Saborly.
- [Orange Blue Mocktail](https://saborly.es/videos/mocktail-orange-blue/): The Orange Blue Mocktail: a layered blue-and-green alcohol-free drink with fresh mint — only at Saborly.
- [¿Se te antoja algo? ¡Ven y come!](https://saborly.es/videos/ven-y-come-ahora/): Crispy chicken burgers and beef cheeseburgers, made to order — at C/ de Pere IV 208 (Barcelona) and Av. Francesc Macià 47 (Sabadell).
- [Tarta Red Velvet](https://saborly.es/videos/tarta-red-velvet/): Our Red Velvet Cake: soft red sponge with layers of cream — perfect with coffee or tea.
